💌 A message from James

To my beautiful Cynthia

Hey, my love… ❤️ To the most beautiful, wonderful, and lovely person in my life: you make my world brighter in ways I can’t always explain. I’m grateful for your patience, your kindness, your beautiful heart, your advice, your laughter, and the way you keep choosing us. Our story may have started in an unexpected way, but you have become someone truly special to me. I don’t promise to be perfect; I promise to keep learning, listening, showing up, and loving you with honesty and care. You are not just someone I miss when we’re apart. You are someone I want to celebrate, encourage, and build beautiful memories with. Wherever life takes us, I hope we keep choosing kindness, trust, laughter, and each other. Welcome to this little world I made for you. Every colour, every game, and every surprise says the same thing: I love you, Cynthia. Today, tomorrow, and one sweet moment at a time. 💗 Yours always, James. ❤️
